faq.q1: How does the Request for Quote process work?
faq.a1: Browse our catalog and add the items you need. Our engineering team will review your project scope and provide a detailed, zero-obligation commercial proposal.
faq.q2: What types of sectors and facilities do you equip?
faq.a2: We cover the government, public, and private sectors. We fully equip all types of turnkey projects including corporate offices, hospitals, universities, schools, hotels, theaters, and cultural centers.
faq.q3: Can our procurement team inspect the products prior to contracting?
faq.a3: Absolutely. We welcome your engineering and procurement teams to visit our showrooms to physically inspect our premium furniture and appliances before finalizing any agreement.
